businesses.business: regulated electric and natural gas utility

offering_description.value: Generates, transmits and distributes electricity and distributes natural gas to residential, commercial and industrial customers in the Pacific Northwest. Operates hydroelectric, natural gas and other generation plus transmission and distribution networks under state-regulated rates.

primary_services.value: electric transmission and distribution; natural gas distribution; energy efficiency programs

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential electric and natural gas customers; B2B: commercial and industrial customers, wholesale power purchasers and utilities; B2G: municipal and public facilities customers

end_markets.value: residential energy; commercial and industrial energy; wholesale power markets

revenue_model.value: service fees: regulated retail rates for electricity and natural gas delivery and supply; product sales: wholesale electricity and natural gas sales into energy markets

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates generation plants, transmission lines and distribution networks, selling to retail and wholesale customers; distributor: buys natural gas supply and delivers it through its distribution system to end users

geography_served.value: US regional: Eastern Washington, northern Idaho and parts of Oregon (natural gas)

specialization.value: related lines: electric generation and delivery plus natural gas distribution

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utility-owned wires and pipelines serving retail customers directly; other: wholesale sales through energy markets and bilateral contracts

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rate-regulated utility overseen by Washington UTC, Idaho PUC, Oregon PUC, FERC, plus environmental and hydro licensing rules
